shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git branch --show-current && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && rg -n \"afterModelResponse|lastUsage|UsageMetadata|validated by|specs/.*#\" src specs CHANGELOG* package.json | head -240"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' src/types/ai.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && rg -n -C 5 \"receives collected response text and usage|afterModelResponse\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md && ls scripts/spec-links scripts 2>/dev/null | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "ls src/orchestration/*Usage* 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '470,570p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '20,45p' src/types/index.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#|@spec|spec:\" src scripts | head -100
cat package.json | sed -n '1,120p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+\" --glob '*.test.ts' . | head -80
sed -n '1,120p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
sed -n '120,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md | sed -n '1,120p'
rg -n \"scriptedProvider|STOP_FOR_TOOL|STOP_DONE\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -30"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator tool loop reports total usage across every provider call$'"' --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,18p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '525,580p' && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator tool loop reports total usage across every provider call$'"' --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '550,585p' && timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts -t '"'^ChatOrchestrator tool loop reports total usage across every provider call$'"' --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/types/index.ts && git commit -m "Aggregate usage across provider calls" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git status --short --branch'
